Calculate geodesics, redshift, lensing, horizons and deviation in Schwarzschild and weak-wave spacetimes.

decks.subject: physics
decks.title: Solid-State Physics
decks.description: Connect solid structure to elementary physical properties.

includes: Lattices, diffraction, phonons, bands, semiconductors and transport evidence

practice: Calculate a band model and reconcile unfamiliar diffraction and transport measurements.

outcomes.description: Derive Bloch, tight-binding and nearly-free-electron models; calculate band filling, carrier statistics and elementary transport.
Construct real and reciprocal lattices; calculate diffraction conditions, phonon modes and lattice heat capacity.
Infer bounded structural and electronic properties from diffraction, Hall, conductivity and thermal data; assess degeneracies and approximation limits.

decks.subject: biology
decks.title: Molecular and Cellular Biophysics
decks.description: Infer molecular energetics and dynamics from measurements.

includes: Binding, folding, polymer mechanics, molecular stochastic dynamics and single-molecule inference

practice: Fit competing energy landscapes to single-molecule data and propose discriminating perturbations.

outcomes.description: Develop discrete kinetic and bounded overdamped diffusion models for conformations and motors, deriving drift-diffusion moments and fluctuation assumptions.
Derive binding, folding, cooperativity and polymer elasticity from partition functions; compare structural and free-energy interpretations.
Infer states, energies and rates from explained force, fluorescence-transfer and correlation measurement models; test resolution and identifiability.

decks.subject: biology
decks.title: Disease Ecology and Epidemiology
decks.description: Infer disease dynamics and compare interventions.

includes: Transmission, causal study designs, surveillance and intervention judgment

practice: Analyze an outbreak with transmission and observational models and defend an uncertainty-aware intervention.

outcomes.description: Analyze cohorts, case-control and surveillance data using risks, odds and standardization; develop causal diagrams for confounding and selection.
Fit bounded transmission models by parameter comparison; propagate uncertainty and justify equity, privacy, resistance and ecological tradeoffs.
Derive SIR, vector and reservoir models and reproduction thresholds; analyze immunity, vaccination and contact structure.

decks.subject: biology
decks.title: Neuroscience
decks.description: Connect neural activity to circuit function.

includes: Membrane models, synapses, sensory and motor circuits, plasticity and recordings

practice: Analyze sensory recordings and design a test separating encoding from causal function.

outcomes.description: Trace sensory, motor and autonomic pathways; explain circuit motifs, plasticity, memory and behavior.
Calculate explained Nernst equilibrium potentials; interpret action potentials, synapses and excitation-inhibition integration.
Interpret clamp, extracellular, imaging, lesion and perturbation evidence; distinguish tuning, correlation, necessity and sufficiency.

decks.subject: biology
decks.title: Synthetic Biology and Biotechnology
decks.description: Engineer and evaluate bounded biological functions.

includes: Genetic circuits, pathway engineering, design-build-test cycles and containment judgment

practice: Complete an authorized design-build-test project or executable design proposal with burden and escape tests.

outcomes.description: Translate specifications into genetic logic, feedback and pathway models; predict performance and resource burden.
Design constructs, hosts, assembly and assays; use perturbation-driven iteration to improve expression, flux and dynamics.
Evaluate reproducibility, evolutionary escape, containment and dual-use consequences; justify a bounded deployment decision.

decks.subject: chemistry
decks.title: Advanced Synthesis and Catalysis
decks.description: Defend catalytic and stereoselective routes.

includes: Catalytic cycles, asymmetric synthesis, mechanistic evidence and complex strategy

practice: Propose a stereoselective catalytic route and revise its mechanism using kinetics and spectra.

outcomes.description: Construct and discriminate organometallic cycles using elementary steps, rate laws, isotope effects and intermediate spectra.
Compare asymmetric catalysis, auxiliaries and substrate control through transition-state models and stereochemical evidence.
Defend complex-target routes using selectivity, robustness, step economy, supply, safety, waste and analytical feasibility.

decks.subject: chemistry
decks.title: Computational Chemistry
decks.description: Perform reproducible molecular calculations.

includes: SCF implementation, electronic tools, geometry search, dynamics and free energies

practice: Implement SCF and complete a free-energy comparison with reproducible convergence and sensitivity studies.

outcomes.description: Implement small-basis Hartree-Fock SCF from supplied integrals; explain and compare tool-based DFT and correlated methods.
Optimize geometries and transition-state candidates; execute force-field dynamics and derived free-energy estimators with ensemble and convergence controls.
Assess basis, functional, force-field, finite-size and sampling errors against independent structural and energetic evidence.

decks.subject: chemistry
decks.title: Chemical Dynamics
decks.description: Connect molecular motion with reaction and relaxation rates.

includes: Transition states, diffusion-limited rates, surface catalysis and nonadiabatic models

practice: Discriminate molecular, surface and diffusion-limited explanations for new kinetic data.

outcomes.description: Derive collision and transition-state rates from partition functions; compare entropy, tunneling and recrossing effects.
Construct adsorption-reaction networks and derive bounded Marcus or avoided-crossing rate models with explicit assumptions.
Derive reaction-diffusion and diffusion-limited encounter models in bounded planar and radial geometries; distinguish kinetic and transport control.

decks.subject: chemistry
decks.title: Soft Materials and Interfaces
decks.description: Derive physical behavior of soft and interfacial materials.

includes: Polymer and colloid thermodynamics, phase separation, relaxation and scattering inference

practice: Predict phase and relaxation behavior for a new formulation and test it against scattering and rheological data.

outcomes.description: Derive bounded viscoelastic and polymer relaxation models; predict creep, oscillatory response and relaxation spectra.
Derive polymer mixing, chain statistics and colloidal interaction models; calculate coexistence and stability boundaries.
Infer structural and dynamic parameters from explained scattering and rheological measurement models; test nonuniqueness and preparation effects.

decks.subject: chemistry
decks.title: Advanced Molecular Spectroscopy
decks.description: Derive molecular signals and infer dynamics.

includes: Transition response, line shapes, spin Hamiltonians, relaxation and dynamic inference

practice: Derive spin or vibrational responses and fit bounded dynamic models to complementary spectra.

outcomes.description: Infer conformational exchange and intermediates from complementary spectra; test assignment, time-resolution and instrument ambiguities.
Develop density-matrix spin dynamics and NMR/EPR Hamiltonians; derive couplings, pulse rotations, relaxation and bounded two-dimensional responses.
Derive bounded time-dependent perturbation response, polarization rules and line shapes for rotational, vibrational, Raman and electronic spectra.

decks.subject: physics
decks.title: Condensed-Matter Theory
decks.description: Explain collective material behavior beyond independent particles.

includes: Many-body response, magnetism, superconductivity and topological bands

practice: Compare interacting and band explanations of unfamiliar spectral and transport data.

outcomes.description: Derive elementary magnetic and superconducting mean-field theories and compare order parameters, gaps and experimental signatures.
Construct interacting lattice models and derive bounded Green-function and linear-response observables and excitation spectra.
Calculate Berry phases and bounded band invariants with locally developed gauge geometry; connect bulk structure to boundary and transport evidence.

decks.subject: physics
decks.title: Quantum Field Theory
decks.description: Calculate controlled relativistic quantum predictions.

includes: Relativistic fields, quantization, amplitudes, gauge symmetry and renormalization
excludes: Quantum gravity and nonperturbative frontier programs

practice: Calculate a simple scattering prediction through a stated perturbative order and check symmetry and scale dependence.

outcomes.description: Derive propagators and Feynman rules; calculate tree-level scattering and decay in scalar and electromagnetic models.
Derive scalar, spinor and gauge equations and currents; quantize free fields with commutation or anticommutation relations.
Regularize a representative one-loop integral; identify counterterms and derive bounded renormalization-group and effective-theory interpretations.

decks.subject: biology
decks.title: Computational and Systems Neuroscience
decks.description: Infer neural computation through dynamic models.

includes: Conductance models, neural dynamics, plasticity, encoding and decoding

practice: Implement a neural model and decoder and challenge predictions using held-out recordings and interventions.

outcomes.description: Fit encoding models and Bayesian decoders from explicit likelihoods; assess held-out prediction, latent ambiguity and perturbation evidence.
Construct recurrent rate and spiking networks with plasticity; analyze stability, oscillations and stimulus responses.
Derive cable, conductance and integrate-and-fire models with explained compartment discretization and channel-state assumptions; implement simulations.
